Everything you need to know about Gnani's Voice AI platform, models, and deployment.

What is Gnani AI?

Gnani AI is a frontier AI company that builds proprietary speech and language models for enterprise deployments. Its model stack includes Gnani Prisma v2.5 (Speech-to-Text), Gnani Timbre v2.5 (Text-to-Speech), Gnani Warp (Speech-to-Speech), and language model Gnani Evon. Enterprise products built on these models include voice agents, speech analytics, agent assist, and voice biometrics. Gnani's models are trained on 14 million hours of telephonic audio across 40+ languages and serve 250+ enterprises in banking, insurance, healthcare, and government - processing over 50 million voice interactions daily.

What is frontier AI?

Frontier AI represents the absolute pinnacle of artificial intelligence capabilities the most advanced, general-purpose models available at any given time. Because the artificial intelligence landscape evolves at a rapid pace, "frontier" is a moving target: today’s bleeding-edge breakthrough naturally becomes tomorrow’s mainstream standard.

Why choose Gnani AI over general-purpose AI providers for enterprise voice?

Gnani AI is purpose-built for telephonic-grade voice, where general-purpose AI models underperform. Most AI speech models are trained on clean studio audio; enterprise voice involves background noise, regional accents, and code-switching. Gnani's models are trained on 14 million hours of exactly that audio, ranking #1 on 8 of 9 Indian languages on the Kathbath Noisy benchmark. Gnani also supports on-premise, private cloud, and air-gapped deployment - a requirement for regulated industries that has made it the choice of 200+ enterprises.

Which languages does Gnani AI support?

Gnani AI's speech models support 40+ languages and dialects, with deep coverage across Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali, Gujarati, Marathi, Punjabi, and Spanish. Models are trained on multilingual and code-switched audio, enabling reliable transcription and synthesis in real conversations where speakers shift between languages - a common pattern in Indian enterprise environments across BFSI, telecom, and customer service.

How does Gnani AI handle data privacy and regulatory compliance?

Gnani AI supports cloud, private cloud, on-premise, and air-gapped deployment, giving enterprises full control over where voice data is processed and stored. This architecture meets data residency requirements for regulated industries including banking (RBI), insurance (IRDAI), and healthcare. No customer voice data is used for model training without explicit agreement. Gnani is SOC 2 certified, ISO 27001 certified, and compliant with GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS.
